examples.arabic: صاحبي جاب جون وانا استمتعت بالوقت
examples.english: My friend scored a goal and I enjoyed the time
examples.transliteration: sahby gab gon wana estamtaat bel waet

examples.arabic: حلو اوي، وانا هشوف فيلم جديد في وقت فراغي.
examples.english: Very nice, and I will watch a new movie in my free time.
examples.transliteration: Helw awi, wa ana hashoof film gedid fi wakt faraghi.

examples.arabic: الشاب قال مفيش وقت للاكل ونزل الشارع
examples.english: The young man said there is no time for food and went down to the street
examples.transliteration: El shab aal mafeesh waet lel akl wa nezel el sharea

examples.arabic: مفيش وقت خلاص انا لازم انزل دلوقتي
examples.english: There's no time already I must go down now
examples.transliteration: Mafeesh wa't khalas ana lazim anzil dilwa'ti

examples.english: There isn't much time before work.
Everyone is ready for fun and a nice time!
examples.transliteration: El-koll gahez lel-mot3a w el-waqt el-7elw.
